configuration: Release, arm64, ad hoc signed, separate bundle identifiers

tinydash.command: bun run tauri build --bundles app --config tauri-perf.json

bopop.assembly: Support/assemble-app.sh using swift build -c release --arch arm64 --show-bin-path
bopop.source_patch: Change only the dev data folder name in Storage.swift to Bopop Perf 20260919.

tinycast.command: xcodebuild -project Tinycast.xcodeproj -scheme Tinycast -configuration Release -derivedDataPath tinycast-build ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER=com.tinycast.app.performance.20260919 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

profiles.all: Fresh test settings and empty history; clipboard capture off; no extensions or custom scripts; shared hotkey Control+Option+Shift+Space.

method.query_timer: One whole query Unicode keyboard event to expected non-input accessibility text; no-match query and absent-result check before each sample. Timer excludes select-all and preparation.
method.summon_timer: Global hotkey posting to on-screen app window at least 200 by 60 pixels and an accessible input field. Does not verify first painted pixel or keyboard focus.
method.memory: RUSAGE_INFO_V2 physical footprint and RSS, summed over the app and processes attributed to it by responsibility_get_pid_responsible_for_pid. Does not include WindowServer.
method.cpu: Sum of user and system CPU-time deltas over the idle sample interval, divided by elapsed time. 100% means one CPU core.
method.statistics: Median and nearest-rank p95 for pooled latency samples; median of three trial medians for memory; median of three CPU intervals.
